name: schmas
description: Public Claude Code plugins and mods by schmas.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Clean View mod: a calm, non-technical view of Claude Code. Hides tool calls, diffs and command output, and shows one plain-English checklist with progress meters above the prompt. Three modes: on (hide details), both (details plus checklist), off. Switch with the band button or /simple on|both|off.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Toolbox mod: an orange button under the prompt opens a panel to switch the session model and effort in one click. Other mods can add rows to it (Clean View adds its mode switch). Toggle with the button or /toolbox.
